title: Anamim
description: People descended from Mizraim (Gen 10:13-14). Genesis lists this name with a plural or gentilic form (a people/clan); it is kept as a person record so the family tree links up.

sorting_basis.note: No tier 1-4 dates this record's birth; unsorted (null).

birth.note: pending CFAH reference. CFAH dates the Table-of-Nations framework (first territorial division AP-27, 2254 BC; final division AP-28, 2247 BC; Dispersion AP-2, 2192/2191 BC) but not this individual birth

Ussher (Annals) gives no birth year for this name.

birth.citation: Jordan, "The Chronology of the Pentateuch (Part 3)," Biblical Chronology 6:5 (May 1994), §8 "The Table of Nations", table "An Hypothetical Chronology for the Table of Nations"
birth.note: Jordan: "If we assume births every two years, and about 30 years between generations ... we can come up with an approximate series of dates" (hypothetical, not stated by Scripture). Name appears on a continuation line printed beneath this year row in the web text of the table (flattened layout); Jordan's spacing places it with that year.

death.citation: Shuckford, The Sacred and Profane History of the World Connected, 5th ed., revised by James Creighton (London: William Baynes, 1819), vol. 1, Book IV, p. 191 (facsimile PDF p. 287)
death.note: Ananim, also called Curudes, king of Lower Egypt. Shuckford is reporting Syncellus. The person record is the Gen 10 name Anamim. See open question J7 only for Athothes; this attachment is the Gen 10 name he is discussing.
